about.h2: Two apartments, one house, room enough for everyone.
about.imgAlt: Petrčane from the air — a turquoise bay with a marina, the village, vineyards and Velebit in the background
about.lead: Mare and Gumbek are two independent apartments in the same house in Petrčane, a quiet village on the Zadar riviera. Each has its own entrance, kitchen, bathroom, air conditioning and outdoor space — Mare a garden and a large covered terrace, Gumbek a balcony and two floors.
about.p2: That is why they are most often taken by two families or groups of friends travelling together: the children play in the courtyard, dinner is shared on the terrace, and when the day is over everyone returns to their own apartment. No reception, no corridors, no neighbours on the other side of a thin wall — just two locked doors and two holidays that do not have to be coordinated.
about.p3: You are welcome to take just one, of course. Both are equipped for a real holiday rather than a quick look around: dishwasher, hob, coffee machine, TV, fast Wi-Fi and a free parking space in the courtyard.

ac.d: In both apartments, so even an August afternoon passes in the cool.

beach.d: About ten minutes of easy walking to Donje Petrčane beach, with no main road to cross.

kitchen.d: Oven, hob, dishwasher, microwave, coffee machine and enough crockery for the whole party.

outdoor.d: Mare has a garden and a covered terrace with an outdoor kitchen, Gumbek a balcony with an awning.

parking.d: Your own space in the courtyard, right by the entrance — no driving around looking for one.

wifi.d: In both apartments, with no data limit — enough for working remotely too.

mare.desc: A ground-floor apartment with its own garden and a covered terrace that is really a second living room — it has an outdoor kitchen with a sink, a stone fireplace for grilling and a table for six.
